description: Fix 3D PnL graph showing 'Not enough data' for open trades by resolving timestamp matching and single-point rendering issues.
steps: Replace exact string key matching in intraday modes with binary-search nearest-match using 5-min tolerance to handle Kite API timestamp format variations
Change 'not enough data' threshold from points.length < 2 to points.length === 0 so single data points render
Only render Line component when 2+ points exist; single points still show as spheres
Verify tsc -b and vite build pass
acceptance_criteria: Intraday modes (1W, 5m, 1m) match buy/sell timestamps within 5-min tolerance instead of exact string match
Graph renders with even a single data point (as a sphere in 3D space)
Line is only drawn when 2+ points exist
vite build produces a bundle without errors
findings: The root cause was that Kite historical API returns timestamps with varying formats (e.g. '+05:30' vs '+0530' vs space-separated) so exact string-based Map lookups always failed. Binary search on parsed numeric timestamps with 5-min tolerance resolves this. Additionally, trades opened recently may only have 1-2 data points in daily mode, so the threshold was too strict at < 2.
